candidates.source_name: Evropska sredstva (evropskasredstva.si) - official SI cohesion policy 2021-2027 portal
candidates.why_relevant: Successor/companion to eu-skladi.si and the official managing-authority portal for the 2021-2027 European Cohesion Policy Programme in Slovenia. Publishes javni razpisi/javni pozivi, the implementation-system description (OSUN), selection criteria and beneficiary/operation lists. Cohesion-funded IT and digitalisation operations touching financial infrastructure (SID banka financial instruments, Sklad skladov) are announced and later reported here, and it points onward to Uradni list and to the sectoral ministries that actually run the calls.
candidates.legal_status: public sector information, Slovenian PSI/re-use regime likely applies

eu-skladi.si javni razpis digitalizacija finančne storitve

candidates.source_name: eu-skladi.si - legacy Slovenian EU cohesion funds portal (2014-2020 and archive)
candidates.why_relevant: Historical and still-referenced portal of the Government Office for Development and European Cohesion Policy (SVRK). Holds the archive of prior-period calls, beneficiary lists and decisions on co-financing (e.g. SME digital transformation calls funded from ESRR). Useful as the retrospective baseline against which current award activity in financial-sector digitalisation is compared, and as an alias/redirect pointer to evropskasredstva.si.

candidates.source_name: Uradni list RS - Razpisi section (official gazette, legally binding text of every javni razpis)
candidates.why_relevant: Every Slovenian public call co-financed from RRF (NOO) or cohesion funds must be published in the official gazette, and the gazette text is the authoritative version: budget, legal basis, component/investment code (e.g. C3K1, C2K7, REPowerEU C5K17), implementing body and eligible costs. This is the single most reliable, structured, machine-harvestable channel for donor/EU-financed call announcements in Slovenia, including any that touch financial-sector IT.
candidates.source_subtype: official gazette / legal publication of record
candidates.access_status: open web; razpisi content appears publicly readable, some gazette content may sit behind subscription
candidates.legal_status: official state publication; re-use of legal texts generally permitted, verify terms of use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-filtered crawl of the glasilo vsebina URLs with Slovenian filters (NOO, okrevanje in odpornost, kohezijsk, digitaln, informacijski sistem, plačil, banka); URLs are stable and slug-encode the call title
candidates.discovered_via_method: recurring domain across multiple sl-language searches for NOO and cohesion calls
queries_used: Urad RS za okrevanje in odpornost URSOO gov.si javni razpisi NOO seznam

candidates.why_relevant: URSOO (body within the Ministry of Finance) is the coordinating authority for Slovenia's RRF plan and holds the plan text, its addenda and the mapping of components/investments (including digitalisation of public administration and the economy) to responsible ministries. It is the authoritative index for deciding which ministry will publish which digitalisation call, and therefore where to point downstream tender monitors.

candidates.source_name: Portal javnih naročil / eNaročanje (enarocanje.si) - national procurement portal, EU-cofinanced notices
candidates.why_relevant: Although this is the national portal (cell 11 focuses on donor/EU channels), NOO- and cohesion-financed contracts are executed through it and the notice text names the funding source and the component code (an observed example cites measure C2K71G, modernisation of the digital environment of public administration). This is the point where EU-financed digitalisation money becomes an actual contract and an actual named winning vendor, so it is the crosswalk between the donor channel and award evidence.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenian RRF (NOO) or cohesion call was found that is explicitly scoped to banking, payments or financial-institution IT. The digitalisation calls located (P4D 2025, JR-DIGIT-NOO, JR DEMO PILOTI NOO, JR INVEST2024-NOO, digital transformation of NGOs, digital innovation in the cultural/media sector) are horizontal enterprise or public-administration measures under which a bank or payments firm could be an eligible applicant, but none names the financial sector.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in Slovenian with combinations of 'razpis' + 'digitalizacija/digitalna preobrazba' + 'banka/plačila/finančne storitve' and in English via the EU-funds route; only horizontal measures surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means the donor-financed channel for SI banking/payments should be monitored by beneficiary identity and by CPV/technology scope rather than by sector keyword - a keyword-only monitor on 'banka' will return near-zero recall against these portals.

negative_findings.description: No World Bank procurement or consultant-selection notice specific to Slovenia's financial sector was located. Slovenia is a graduate country engaging the World Bank principally through Reimbursable Advisory Services rather than IPF lending, and RAS engagements do not generate the standard borrower-procurement notice stream.
negative_findings.result_summary: The RAS concept pages, the ECA regional RAS brief and the general procurement dataset were found, but no Slovenia financial-sector notice.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The World Bank leg of this cell should be kept at low polling priority and treated as an exception-detection watch, not a routine feed; effort is better spent on EBRD/EIB/EIF where SI financial-institution activity is demonstrable.

negative_findings.description: There is no single national register of RRF-financed tenders in Slovenia. NOO calls are dispersed across URSOO, individual ministries (MDP, MGTS), and agencies (SPIRIT, ARIS), each with its own razpisi subsite, with Uradni list as the only common denominator.
negative_findings.result_summary: Repeated Slovenian-language searches for a consolidated 'seznam razpisov NOO' returned agency-level subsites, not a central register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Coverage must be built as a federation of per-issuer crawls anchored on Uradni list; assuming a single NOO portal exists would silently drop most of the call stream.

negative_findings.description: The IFI leg of this cell (EBRD, EIB, EIF, World Bank) has no Slovenian-language publication channel. All notices for these bodies are published in English only, including those addressed to Slovenian financial institutions such as the Bank of Slovenia assignment identified on ebrd.com.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian-language searches combining IFI acronyms with 'razpis'/'javno naročilo' returned only domestic-portal material and Slovenian press coverage, never an IFI-hosted Slovenian-language notice.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Satisfies the mandatory local-language check for this sub-domain with a negative result: local-language monitoring adds no recall on the IFI channel, so the English feeds must carry it alone.

negative_findings.description: The extent of anonymous public read access to EBRD's ECEPP notice search was not established in this pass; documentation emphasises supplier registration.
negative_findings.result_summary: ECEPP identified as the operative EBRD client procurement platform, but read-access model unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If ECEPP notices are only visible after registration, the EBRD notice board and PDF document paths on ebrd.com become the sole open channel and monitoring design must depend on them. Registration would require accepting platform terms - a human decision, not an automated one.

coverage_gaps.description: TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) was not systematically probed in this pass as a route to Slovenian EU-co-financed award notices above threshold. TED carries structured award data including winning-vendor names and is the natural EU-level complement to enarocanje.si.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated TED probe: query by country=SI, CPV 72xxx/48xxx IT codes, and the EU-funds flag, and evaluate the TED API for structured ingestion.

coverage_gaps.description: Audit and control bodies were not covered: Računsko sodišče RS (Court of Audit), the Urad RS za nadzor proračuna / AFCOS function, and the European Court of Auditors. Their reports name specific EU-financed IT projects, contract values and irregularities - an independent evidence channel on donor-financed procurement outcomes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on rs-rs.si, the budget-supervision office on gov.si, and eca.europa.eu for Slovenia-specific RRF/cohesion audit reports touching digitalisation.

coverage_gaps.description: Several candidate landing pages were inferred from search-result context rather than fetched: the URSOO NOO page on gov.si, the SPIRIT razpisi index, the MDP razpisi listing, and the EIB projects search endpoint. Their exact current URLs may differ.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Have the deterministic liveness pass resolve each of these root URLs and record the canonical path; do not treat any non-200 as a dead source without a second check.

coverage_gaps.description: IFC (World Bank Group private-sector arm) and the Council of Europe Development Bank were not searched, and the EIB Group's own corporate procurement/consultancy notice board was noted only indirectly. Each can finance or advise Slovenian financial institutions.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the IFI sweep to ifc.org disclosure and procurement, coebank.org, and the EIB corporate procurement notices page, filtered on Slovenia.

coverage_gaps.description: The Slovenian glossary built here covers funding and procurement vocabulary (javni razpis, javni poziv, javno naročilo, obvestilo o oddaji naročila, NOO, EKP, ESRR, kohezijski sklad, finančni posrednik, Sklad skladov, sofinanciranje, operacija, upravičenec) but is thin on payments-specific Slovenian technical terms in a procurement context (e.g. plačilni sistem, kartično poslovanje, bankomat, POS terminal, jedrni bančni sistem).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and test a payments-technical Slovenian term list against enarocanje.si and Uradni list before finalising the monitoring queries for this cell.

brief: Donor and EU-fund financed procurement touching Slovenian banking and payments splits into two structurally different landscapes. Domestically, RRF (NOO) and cohesion money is announced through a federated set of Slovenian-language channels with Uradni list as the only universal publication of record, evropskasredstva.si and URSOO as the programme-level indexes, individual ministries and agencies (MDP, MGTS, SPIRIT, ARIS) as the actual issuers, and enarocanje.si plus the OPSI award dataset as the point where the money becomes a named contract with a named vendor; crucially, none of the calls found are sector-scoped to finance, so monitoring must key on beneficiary identity and CPV rather than the word 'banka'. The IFI leg is English-only and independent of the national portals: EBRD (notice board, ECEPP, and project summary documents - one of which is a real Bank of Slovenia advisory assignment), EIF (Slovenia-specific SEGIP calls plus a published list of selected Slovenian intermediaries, effectively an award record), and EIB (SID banka intermediated operations), with the World Bank sparse because Slovenia engages it mainly through fee-paid advisory rather than lending. The highest-value and most distinctive nodes for this cell are SID banka and its Sklad skladov vehicle, which sit at the junction of both landscapes and publish their own procurement and intermediary-selection results. Main open risks are the absence of a TED probe, no coverage yet of audit bodies, and a payments-technical Slovenian glossary that is not yet built.
